verdict.rationale: The documented careers-page path is API-driven: a 3-step guide to building a custom careers page, plus a public Job Posting API for teams that host their own page. That is engineering work, which runs against the story's 'no engineering' requirement. Community reports of applying to jobs 'hosted on Ashby' imply some Ashby-hosted job listings exist, but nothing documents branding or custom-domain support. missing for 10: first-party docs for a no-code hosted careers page, custom domain support, branding/theming controls, and confirmation that jobs auto-publish without development.
